secrets.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Telegram bot token (from @BotFather) used to send a message to the salon chat for every new booking.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional — Resend API key used to deliver booking and gift-card emails. Without it, emails are recorded in the dashboard outbox.

secrets.name: EMAIL_FROM
secrets.description: Optional — verified sender for Resend, e.g. 'LUMIÈRE Hair Salon <hello@yourdomain.com>'.
